data.gender_notes: Prayansh is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Prayansh is derived from the Sanskrit words ‘prayatna’ which means effort and ‘ansh’ which means part or progress. It is a name that signifies the progress and growth of an individual towards their future goals. It is a name that inspires determination and hard work. The name Prayansh carries the meaning “Progress, Future, Prosperity” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit. Parents who choose Prayansh usually hope their child will grow to embody progress, future, prosperity and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Prayansh is a name that is deeply rooted in the spiritual traditions of Hinduism. It is believed to be a name that is blessed by the gods and brings prosperity and success to the individual. It is a name that inspires spiritual growth and self-realization.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Prayansh total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.
